options.discovery: the lab's screen for a one-instrument positional strategy on 2023-11-10 .. 2025-12-16: net > 0 in H1 and H2, PF >= 1.15, >= 60 trades

engines.nse: options_r4 / kite_options through nsedata.make_simulator with nsedata._close_position wrapped; the wrapper's one-lot twin must equal the stored DISCOVERY result
engines.replay: stored per-leg trade files of options_vrp / options_r3 re-sized exactly (gross x lot ratio; fees = Rs 23.60 per order with a positive value + the proportional part x the lot ratio); the stored files reproduce the stored results at the original lots

options.fees: per leg at the real lot count: options_replay.leg_cost (costs.round_trip_cost 'option'); fill haircut per unit unchanged
options.final: one look per DISCOVERY passer at the new size (options_final_ledger.json, first write wins); CONFIRMED = net > 0 and PF >= 1.05. Replay strategies: the stored FINAL trades when the file has them (FINAL already opened at one lot), otherwise NOT AVAILABLE here (the model engine is not re-run) and the strategy cannot be proven; nse strategies: the simulator on the FINAL window

lots.caveat: exchange freeze quantities (orders above them are split, each paying Rs 20) are not modelled; cheap long structures can reach hundreds of lots
lots.decided: at entry, from entry prices only; one lot count per trade for all its legs
lots.defined_risk_short: max(1, floor(100000 / max risk per lot)); max risk = the worst expiry payoff of the structure at its entry prices (all legs one expiry, no uncovered short call or put)
lots.long_or_debit: max(1, floor(100000 / net premium paid per lot))
lots.naked_short: max(1, floor(500000 / margin per lot)); margin = the trade record's own margin estimate (options_replay) where present, else 12% x mean short strike x lot size; a credit structure with an uncovered short or legs in different expiries is sized by this rule

options.not_included: option strategies without a stored per-leg trade file or a callable EOD simulator (VRP-WINGED-HIGHVIX, old-era option runs): their earlier verdicts stand
options.old_era: no old-era option trade record carries per-leg prices, so an OOS judgement at the new size is NOT AVAILABLE; an option strategy therefore cannot be PROVEN by this re-test. Its one-lot old-era verdict is reported next to its FINAL result. (Known erratum: old-era EOD option settlement prices are 0 on weekly expiries before 2020-01.)
